question: What becomes attainable for one who remembers the terrible southern goddess?
premises: Nothing is hard to obtain for that person.
The condition is remembering the terrible southern goddess.
inference: Remembering the terrible southern goddess makes all things attainable.
uncertainties: ghora+dakṣiṇām is taken as an epithet of Kālī/Dakṣiṇā.
plain_english: Nothing is hard to obtain for one who remembers the terrible southern goddess.
